name: Hamilton
takeaway: Hamilton is a large municipal electric utility — cannot sell competitive electric within city limits. However, industrial addresses just outside Hamilton city limits may be in Duke Energy territory and eligible for aggregation. Verify service address carefully.
hook: Do you handle your own electric or is it through the city system?
notes: City of Hamilton (Butler County) operates its own large municipal electric system. Exempt from Ohio retail electric choice within city limits. Adjacent and border addresses may be served by Duke Energy Ohio and ARE eligible for competitive supply. Large industrial accounts on the city fringe are worth investigating by address. Do not call city-addressed accounts for electric supply.
